name: GitHub Repository Analysis - QA Engineer
description: Global parsing rules for QA and test automation repositories. NOTE: Specific evidence mappings (regex patterns and maps_to composite keys) are stored within individual skill files under evidence.github, NOT here. The validate_composite_keys.py script scans both locations to verify coverage.

target_files.notes: Cypress E2E test suites, custom commands, and configuration
Playwright cross-browser test suites, page objects, and fixtures
Postman API test collections and environment configurations
Performance and load testing scripts (JMeter, k6, Gatling)
Automated test execution reports and XML artifacts
CI/CD test automation pipelines and matrix execution jobs
Contract testing definitions and WireMock service stubs
Test planning documentation, test design matrices, and manual test charters

tasks: Map detected test files and dependencies to composite keys ({skill_id}.{subskill_id}) using patterns defined in QA skill files
Differentiate end-to-end integration tests (Playwright, Cypress) from developer-level unit tests
Inspect locator robustness — favor user-facing locators (getByRole, getByTestId) over brittle CSS classes or deep XPath hierarchies
Evaluate test resilience — detect presence of explicit waiting/auto-waiting vs antipattern hardcoded sleeps (cy.wait(5000), time.sleep)
Check performance script configurations for realistic traffic profiles (stages, target RPS, p95/p99 thresholds)
